title: Continuous Evolution Pool: Taming Recurring Concept Drift in Online Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2506.14790v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recurring concept drift is pervasive in real-world online time series, where the underlying data-generating process repeatedly alternates between a small set of regimes, most notably daily or seasonal cycles that dominate energy, traffic, and weather patterns, and is therefore a central obstacle to reliable long-horizon forecasting. This problem poses a dual challenge in online time series forecasting: mitigating catastrophic forgetting while operating under strict constraints that prevent storing or replaying historical raw samples. Existing approaches predominantly rely on parameter updates or experience replay, which inevitably suffer from knowledge overwriting or stale replay buffers. To address this, the Continuous Evolution Pool (CEP), a replay-free framework that maintains a dynamic pool of specialized forecasters, is proposed. translated_title: 连续演化池：驯服在线时间序列预测中的周期性概念漂移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.14790v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：周期性概念漂移在现实世界的在线时间序列中普遍存在，其中底层数据生成过程反复在少量机制之间交替，最显著的是主导能源、交通和天气模式的日循环或季节循环，因此成为可靠长周期预测的主要障碍。这个问题给在线时间序列预测带来了双重挑战：在严格的约束条件下（无法存储或重放历史原始样本）缓解灾难性遗忘。现有方法主要依赖参数更新或经验重放，不可避免地遭受知识覆盖或重放缓冲区过时的问题。为解决这一问题，提出了连续演化池（CEP），一种无重放框架，维护一个动态的专业预测器池。CEP不存储原始样本，而是利用轻量级统计基因来解耦概念识别。
tldr: 本文提出连续演化池（CEP），一种无重放框架，通过轻量级统计基因动态维护专业预测器池，有效解决在线时间序列中周期性概念漂移引起的灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Continuous Evolution Pool (CEP), a replay-free framework that maintains a dynamic pool of specialized forecasters using lightweight statistical genes, effectively addressing catastrophic forgetting caused by recurring concept drift in online time series forecasting.
